description: This file defines an interface 'OutpostsArnInterface' within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically related to S3 Outposts ARNs. It extends another interface 'ArnInterface' and declares a method 'getOutpostId'.

classes.name: OutpostsArnInterface
classes.description: An interface for AWS S3 Outposts ARNs, extending the general ARN interface with a method to retrieve the Outpost ID.

methods.name: getOutpostId
methods.description: Retrieves the Outpost ID associated with the ARN.
